components.name: Accordion
components.description: An accordion is a vertical stack of interactive headings used to toggle the display of further information; each item can be 'collapsed' with just a short label visible or 'expanded' to show the full content.

components.name: Alert
components.description: A way of informing the user of important changes in a prominent way.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A graphical representation of a user: usually a photo, illustration, or initial.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A small label, generally appearing inside or in close proximity to another larger interface component, representing a status, property, or some other metadata.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: A list of links showing the location of the current page in the navigational hierarchy.

components.name: Button
components.description: Buttons trigger an action such as submitting a form or showing/hiding an interface component.

components.name: Button group
components.description: A wrapper for multiple, related buttons.

components.name: Card
components.description: A container for content representing a single entity. e.g. a contact, article, or task.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: A means of displaying multiple slides of content, one or more at a time. Navigation between slides can be controlled via swiping, scrolling, or buttons.

components.name: Color picker
components.description: An input for choosing a color.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: An input that behaves similarly to a select, with the addition of a free text input to filter options.

components.name: Date input
components.description: A means of inputting a date – often separated into multiple individual fields for day/month/year.

components.name: Datepicker
components.description: A visual way to choose a date using a calendar view.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: A panel which slides out from the edge of the screen.

components.name: Dropdown menu
components.description: A menu in which options are hidden by default but can be shown by interacting with a button; it differs from a select in that it shows actions or navigation options and is not a form input.

components.name: Empty state
components.description: An indication to the user that there is no data to display in the current view; it often includes an alternative action (e.g. try a different search term).

components.name: Fieldset
components.description: A wrapper for related form fields.

components.name: File
components.description: A representation of a file such as an uploaded attachment or a downloadable PDF.

components.name: File upload
components.description: An input which allows users to upload a file from their device.

components.name: Footer
components.description: Commonly appearing at the bottom of a page or section, a footer is used to display copyright and legal information or links to related content.

components.name: Form
components.description: A grouping of input controls that allow a user to submit information to a server.

components.name: Header
components.description: An element that appears across the top of all pages on a website or application; it usually contains the site name and main navigation.

components.name: Heading
components.description: A title or caption used to introduce a new section.

components.name: Hero
components.description: A large banner, usually appearing as one of the first items on a page; it often contains a full-width image.

components.name: Icon
components.description: An icon is a graphic symbol designed to visually indicate the purpose of an interface element.

components.name: Image
components.description: An element for embedding images.

components.name: Label
components.description: A text label for form inputs.

components.name: Link
components.description: A link is a reference to a resource. This can be external (e.g. a different web page) or internal (e.g. a specific element in the current document).

components.name: Modal
components.description: A modal is an interface element that appears over other content. It requires an interaction from the user before they can return to whatever is underneath.

components.name: Navigation
components.description: A container for navigation links; these can be to other pages (e.g. main site navigation) or to elements within the current page (e.g. a table of contents).

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Pagination is the process of splitting information over multiple pages instead of showing it all on a single page; also the name for the interface component used for navigating between these pages.

components.name: Popover
components.description: An element that pops up from another element over other content; it differs from a tooltip in that it is usually triggered via click instead of hover and can contain interactive elements.

components.name: Progress bar
components.description: A horizontal bar indicating the current completion status of a long-running task, usually updated continuously as the task progresses, instead of in discrete steps.

components.name: Progress indicator
components.description: A representation of a user’s progress through a series of discrete steps.

components.name: Quote
components.description: Quotes are used to display a quotation: either from a person or another outside source or to highlight a passage of the current document (a pull quote).

components.name: Radio button
components.description: Radio buttons allow a user to select a single option from a list of predefined options.

components.name: Rating
components.description: Ratings let users see and/or set a star rating for a product or other item.

components.name: Rich text editor
components.description: An interface for editing “rich text” content (i.e. with formatting), usually through a WYSIWYG interface.

components.name: Search input
components.description: Search inputs allow users to find content by entering a search term.

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: A hybrid somewhere between a button group, radio buttons, and tabs; segmented controls are used to switch between different options or views.

components.name: Select
components.description: A form input used for selecting a value: when collapsed it shows the currently selected option and when expanded, it shows a scrollable list of predefined options for the user to choose from.

components.name: Separator
components.description: A separator between two elements, usually consisting of a horizontal line.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: A placeholder layout for content which hasn't yet loaded, usually built up of grey boxes.

components.name: Skip link
components.description: Links within a page for skipping to another section, primarily for users who navigate using a keyboard.

components.name: Slider
components.description: A form control for choosing a value within a preset range of values.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: A visual indicator that a process is happening in the background but the interface is not yet ready for interaction.

components.name: Stack
components.description: A wrapper component for adding a consistent margin between components.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: A control for editing a numeric value with buttons for decrementing / incrementing.

components.name: Table
components.description: A component for displaying large amounts of data in rows and columns; commonly referred to as a 'Data Table' when it includes sorting and/ or filtering functionality.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tabbed interfaces are a way of navigating between multiple panels, reducing clutter and fitting more into a smaller space.

components.name: Text input
components.description: A form control that accepts a single line of text.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: A form control for editing multi-line text.

components.name: Toast
components.description: A type of alert which appears in a layer above other content, visually similar to a mobile or desktop push notification.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A control used to switch between two states: often on or off.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A means of displaying a description or extra information about an element, usually on hover, but can also be on click or tap.

components.name: Tree view
components.description: A component for displaying nested hierarchical information, such as a table of contents or directory structure.

components.name: Video
components.description: Video players are used for displaying video content; they often include controls to control playback.

components.name: Visually hidden
components.description: Invisible text used to provide extra context for users of assistive technology.
